name: Nucor
description: Nucor is North America's largest steel recycler and largest US steelmaker by tonnage shipped (about 24.7 million tons to outside customers in 2025). It melts scrap steel in electric arc furnaces and rolls it into sheet, plate, beams and bar. About 62% of external sales are steel mills; another 32% is downstream steel products (joists and deck, rebar fabrication, tubing, metal buildings, insulated panels, racking, towers) which are increasingly non-commodity businesses bought to smooth earnings; the raw-materials segment (scrap brokerage and iron units) mostly supplies Nucor's own mills. Steel mills sell at market-linked prices: about 85% of sheet sales are on 6-to-12-month contracts that reset monthly or quarterly to indices, so profit is the spread between steel price and scrap cost times tons. Nucor pays workers a large profit-sharing component, so labor cost falls when earnings fall.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC 3312 (Steel Works, Blast Furnaces & Rolling Mills).

businessLines.name: Steel mills
businessLines.how: Sells tons of steel to service centers, fabricators and manufacturers; price tracks market indices, cost tracks scrap and energy. Sheet is mostly on 6-12 month contracts re-priced to indices; bar, plate and structural are mostly spot.
businessLines.description: Sheet (hot-rolled, cold-rolled, galvanized), plate, structural beams and bar steel from EAF mills; includes the NuMit joint venture (50%) and trading companies.

operatingProfit.note: segment earnings before income taxes and noncontrolling interests (before corporate/eliminations of -$1,197M); Nucor does not report segment operating profit

businessLines.name: Steel products
businessLines.how: Sells fabricated and engineered products to construction and infrastructure customers, often on project bids; the margin is over the steel it buys from Nucor's own mills and the market. The newer product lines (panels, racking, doors, towers) were acquired to earn better and steadier margins than commodity steel.
businessLines.description: Steel joists and deck, rebar fabrication, tubular products, metal buildings and insulated metal panels, racking, overhead doors, towers and structures, fasteners, wire and mesh, cold-finished bar.

operatingProfit.note: segment earnings before income taxes and noncontrolling interests (before corporate/eliminations of -$1,197M); Nucor does not report segment operating profit

businessLines.name: Raw materials
businessLines.how: Buys and resells scrap and brokered ferrous and non-ferrous metals; DRI plants make iron units for Nucor's own mills. Of its $12,770M total sales, $10,606M is sold to other Nucor segments.
businessLines.description: Scrap brokerage and processing (David J. Joseph, DJJ) and direct-reduced iron (DRI) plants.

operatingProfit.note: segment earnings before income taxes and noncontrolling interests (before corporate/eliminations of -$1,197M); Nucor does not report segment operating profit

brands.name: Nucor-Yamato Steel (51%; only North American maker of high-strength low-alloy beams)
Nucor-JFE Steel Mexico (51%; 400,000 tons galvanized sheet plant)
NuMit LLC / Steel Technologies (50% JV; 30 sheet processing plants)
